title: Man Wanted on Three Warrants Finally Gets Busted
description:
On March 3, 2022, police were attempting to locate a male wanted on three warrants after he fled a traffic stop weeks before in La Crosse, WI. Upon making contact at a particular residence, they observed the male inside the house and set up a perimeter to prevent any attempt of escape. 

For business inquiries or other questions contact:
codebluecam@gmail.com

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.

event_summary.short: Noah Betts, wanted on three warrants, arrested after a brief standoff at a residence in La Crosse, WI, following an earlier vehicle pursuit.

evidence.quote: On March 3, 2022, police were attempting to locate a male wanted on three warrants...
...after he fled a traffic stop weeks before in La Crosse, WI.
The male driver was identified as 22-year-old Noah Betts.
Noah was ultimately taken into custody with three warrants...
...charged with felony counts of fleeing an officer, bail jumping, and misdemeanor operating while revoked.
